id: <repo-name>-<three digit number, unique within the repo>
title: Short description of the weakness
owasp_id: An id from the fetched taxonomy, e.g. the category id shown in owasp-taxonomy.json
owasp_name: The matching category name from the same taxonomy entry
snippets: One or two lines of evidence. Never a live secret.
explain: Why this is a weakness in general.
analysis: What you found in this specific code: how untrusted input reaches the sink, or why it cannot.
remediation: The concrete change that fixes it.
